title: Computer Vision in Wildlife Conservation: review data and code
description: Code and data of the systematic review Computer Vision in Wildlife Conservation: database, library and citation searches, LLM-assisted title/abstract screening and full-text extraction with a frozen protocol (Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Opus 5.5; prompts, JSON schemas and model identifiers included), GBIF taxon matching, the coded corpus of 6,360 papers (2014 to October 2026), the validation checks, the scripts that regenerate every number, table and figure of the article, and an interactive overview of the corpus. Full texts, abstracts and verbatim quotes from the reviewed papers are not included for copyright reasons.
